wins.text: Q3 revenue grew 63% YoY and 18% sequentially to $1.181B, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by 1,300 basis points
U.S. commercial revenue grew 121% YoY and 29% sequentially to $397M; closed $1.3B in U.S. commercial TCV bookings — first time surpassing $1B — representing 342% YoY growth
Adjusted operating margin hit an all-time high of 51%, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by 500 basis points; Rule of 40 score reached an unprecedented 114%, up 20 points sequentially
Closed highest-ever TCV quarter at $2.8B, up 151% YoY, including 204 deals worth $1M+, 91 deals worth $5M+, and 53 deals worth $10M+
Generated $508M in operating cash flow and $540M in adjusted free cash flow in Q3; achieved $2B in trailing 12-month adjusted free cash flow for the first time in company history

risks.text: International commercial revenue grew only 10% YoY and 5% sequentially to $152M — management explicitly acknowledged Europe is 'stagnant' and is a drag on overall growth rates
Q4 revenue from strategic commercial contracts expected to decline to $2M–$4M vs. $9.6M in Q4 2024, with full-year 2025 contribution below 0.5% of revenue — a fading revenue stream
Adjusted expenses up 8% sequentially and 29% YoY, with management flagging continued expense increases in Q4 due to investment in product pipeline and technical hiring

Net dollar retention of 134%, while strong, does not yet fully capture the acceleration in U.S. business since it excludes customers acquired in the past 12 months — metric may be misleading as a growth indicator
Palantir's controversial government work (ICE, Israel, border operations) and Alex Karp's political commentary on the call create ongoing reputational and talent-retention risk

guidance_items.detail: Q4 2025 revenue guided to $1.327B–$1.331B (61% YoY, 13% QoQ — highest-ever sequential growth guide); full-year 2025 raised to $4.396B–$4.400B, up $252M at midpoint vs. prior guide, representing ~53% YoY growth
Full-year U.S. commercial revenue raised to in excess of $1.433B (at least 104% YoY growth), a 19-point increase over guidance given last quarter
Full-year adjusted income from operations raised to $2.151B–$2.155B; Q4 adjusted income from operations guided to $695M–$699M
Full-year adjusted free cash flow guidance raised to $1.9B–$2.1B; full-year Rule of 40 score now guided to 102%

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Acceleration in sales cycles from boot camps — what specifically changed behaviorally from first contact to deal close
Golden Dome and specific named government program opportunities (NGC2, Maven expansion) not proactively discussed
Internal productivity and headcount scaling — how Palantir is keeping up with demand without proportional headcount growth
